BuyForMePricing.jsx

JavaScript
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  ArrowRightOutlined,
  CalculatorOutlined,
  CheckCircleFilled,
  ClockCircleOutlined,
  DollarOutlined,
  FileTextOutlined,
  GlobalOutlined,
  InfoCircleOutlined,
  ReloadOutlined,
  SafetyCertificateOutlined,
  ShoppingCartOutlined,
  StarFilled,
  ThunderboltOutlined,
  WarningOutlined,
} from "@ant-design/icons";

import Header from "../../layouts/HeaderLayout/Headeer";
import "./BuyForMePricing.css";

const COUNTRIES = [
  {
    id: "china",
    name: "Trung Quốc",
    route: "Trung Quốc → Việt Nam",
    currency: "CNY",
    exchangeRate: 3600,
    serviceRate: 0.03,
    minFee: 30000,
    freight: 68000,
    time: "5–10 ngày",
    popular: true,
  },
  {
    id: "japan",
    name: "Nhật Bản",
    route: "Nhật Bản → Việt Nam",
    currency: "JPY",
    exchangeRate: 180,
    serviceRate: 0.04,
    minFee: 50000,
    freight: 155000,
    time: "7–14 ngày",
  },
  {
    id: "korea",
    name: "Hàn Quốc",
    route: "Hàn Quốc → Việt Nam",
    currency: "KRW",
    exchangeRate: 19,
    serviceRate: 0.04,
    minFee: 50000,
    freight: 135000,
    time: "7–12 ngày",
  },
  {
    id: "usa",
    name: "Mỹ / Châu Âu",
    route: "Mỹ / Châu Âu → Việt Nam",
    currency: "USD",
    exchangeRate: 26000,
    serviceRate: 0.05,
    minFee: 80000,
    freight: 245000,
    time: "10–18 ngày",
  },
];

const STEPS = [
  "Gửi link sản phẩm cần mua",
  "Nhận báo giá chi tiết",
  "Thanh toán và xác nhận đặt hàng",
  "Theo dõi đơn đến khi nhận hàng",
];

const NOTES = [
  "Bảng giá chỉ mang tính tham khảo, phí chính thức phụ thuộc link sản phẩm và phí nội địa.",
  "Hàng giá trị cao, hàng thương hiệu hoặc hàng đặc thù có thể cần kiểm tra riêng.",
  "Phí vận chuyển quốc tế được tính theo cân nặng thực tế hoặc cân quy đổi nếu có.",
  "Có thể phát sinh phí đóng gói, bảo hiểm hoặc phụ phí xử lý với một số nhóm hàng.",
];

const formatCurrency = (value) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("vi-VN", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "VND",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(value || 0);

const safeNumber = (value) => {
  const number = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(number) && number > 0 ? number : 0;
};

const BuyForMePricing = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    country: "china",
    productPrice: "",
    quantity: "1",
    domesticShipping: "",
    weight: "",
    insurance: true,
  });

  const country =
    COUNTRIES.find((item) => item.id === form.country) || COUNTRIES[0];

  const calculation = useMemo(() => {
    const productPrice = safeNumber(form.productPrice);
    const quantity = Math.max(1, Math.floor(safeNumber(form.quantity) || 1));
    const domesticShipping = safeNumber(form.domesticShipping);
    const weight = safeNumber(form.weight);

    const goodsForeign = productPrice * quantity + domesticShipping;
    const goodsVnd = goodsForeign * country.exchangeRate;

    const serviceFee = goodsVnd
      ? Math.max(goodsVnd * country.serviceRate, country.minFee)
      : 0;

    const freightFee = weight ? Math.max(weight * country.freight, country.freight * 0.5) : 0;
    const insuranceFee = form.insurance && goodsVnd ? goodsVnd * 0.01 : 0;

    return {
      goodsForeign,
      goodsVnd,
      serviceFee,
      freightFee,
      insuranceFee,
      total: goodsVnd + serviceFee + freightFee + insuranceFee,
    };
  }, [form, country]);

  const updateField = (field, value) => {
    setForm((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [field]: value,
    }));
  };

  const handleNumberChange = (field, value) => {
    if (value === "" || Number(value) >= 0) {
      updateField(field, value);
    }
  };

  const preventInvalidKey = (event) => {
    if (["e", "E", "+", "-"].includes(event.key)) {
      event.preventDefault();
    }
  };

  const scrollToCalculator = () => {
    document
      .getElementById("buyfor-pricing-calculator")
      ?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Header />

      <main className="buyfor-pricing-page">
        <section className="buyfor-pricing-hero">
          <div className="buyfor-pricing-container buyfor-pricing-hero__inner">
            <div className="buyfor-pricing-hero__content">
              <div className="buyfor-pricing-breadcrumb">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => navigate("/")}>
                  Trang chủ
                </button>
                <span>/</span>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => navigate("/bang-gia")}>
                  Bảng giá
                </button>
                <span>/</span>
                <strong>Bảng giá mua hộ</strong>
              </div>

              <span className="buyfor-pricing-eyebrow">
                <DollarOutlined />
                Bảng giá dịch vụ mua hộ
              </span>

              <h1>
                Chi phí mua hộ minh bạch
                <span> trước khi bạn xác nhận đơn</span>
              </h1>

              <p>
                Tham khảo phí mua hộ theo từng thị trường, phí vận chuyển dự
                kiến và các khoản có thể phát sinh khi đặt hàng quốc tế về Việt
                Nam.
              </p>

              <div className="buyfor-pricing-hero__actions">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="buyfor-pricing-btn buyfor-pricing-btn--primary"
                  onClick={scrollToCalculator}
                >
                  Tính phí dự kiến
                  <CalculatorOutlined />
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="buyfor-pricing-btn buyfor-pricing-btn--secondary"
                  onClick={() => navigate("/dich-vu/mua-ho")}
                >
                  Xem dịch vụ mua hộ
                  <ArrowRightOutlined />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="buyfor-pricing-hero__card">
              <div className="buyfor-pricing-card-top">
                <span>
                  <ShoppingCartOutlined />
                </span>
                <div>
                  <small>Ước tính đơn hàng</small>
                  <strong>Order quốc tế</strong>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="buyfor-pricing-preview">
                <div>
                  <span>Tiền hàng</span>
                  <strong>{formatCurrency(1850000)}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>Phí mua hộ từ</span>
                  <strong>3% - 5%</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>Vận chuyển từ</span>
                  <strong>{formatCurrency(68000)}/kg</strong>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="buyfor-pricing-rating">
                <StarFilled />
                <StarFilled />
                <StarFilled />
                <StarFilled />
                <StarFilled />
                <span>Báo giá trước khi đặt mua</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="buyfor-pricing-section">
          <div className="buyfor-pricing-container">
            <div className="buyfor-pricing-heading">
              <span>Bảng phí theo thị trường</span>
              <h2>Phí mua hộ được tính theo giá trị hàng hóa</h2>
              <p>
                Mỗi quốc gia có tỷ giá, phí tối thiểu và đơn giá vận chuyển
                khác nhau. Bạn có thể chỉnh lại dữ liệu này theo bảng giá thật
                của hệ thống.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="buyfor-pricing-grid">
              {COUNTRIES.map((item) => (
                <article
                  className={`buyfor-pricing-country-card ${
                    item.popular ? "is-popular" : ""
                  }`}
                  key={item.id}
                >
                  {item.popular && <span className="popular-badge">Phổ biến</span>}

                  <div className="country-card-icon">
                    <GlobalOutlined />
                  </div>

                  <h3>{item.route}</h3>
                  <p>Thời gian dự kiến: {item.time}</p>

                  <div className="country-card-price">
                    <div>
                      <span>Phí mua hộ</span>
                      <strong>{Math.round(item.serviceRate * 100)}%</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span>Phí tối thiểu</span>
                      <strong>{formatCurrency(item.minFee)}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span>Vận chuyển từ</span>
                      <strong>{formatCurrency(item.freight)}/kg</strong>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      updateField("country", item.id);
                      setTimeout(scrollToCalculator, 60);
                    }}
                  >
                    Tính phí tuyến này
                    <ArrowRightOutlined />
                  </button>
                </article>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="buyfor-pricing-section buyfor-pricing-section--soft">
          <div className="buyfor-pricing-container buyfor-pricing-info-layout">
            <div>
              <div className="buyfor-pricing-heading">
                <span>Cách tính chi phí</span>
                <h2>Các khoản thường có trong một đơn mua hộ</h2>
                <p>
                  Tổng chi phí thường bao gồm tiền hàng, phí mua hộ, vận chuyển
                  quốc tế, bảo hiểm và các phụ phí phát sinh nếu có.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="buyfor-pricing-formula">
                <strong>Tổng dự kiến</strong>
                <span>=</span>
                <p>Tiền hàng quy đổi + Phí mua hộ + Vận chuyển + Bảo hiểm</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="buyfor-pricing-step-list">
              {STEPS.map((step, index) => (
                <article key={step}>
                  <span>{String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
                  <div>
                    <strong>{step}</strong>
                    <p>
                      Quy trình giúp khách hàng chủ động kiểm soát chi phí trước
                      khi đơn hàng được đặt mua.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </article>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section
          className="buyfor-pricing-section buyfor-pricing-calculator-section"
          id="buyfor-pricing-calculator"
        >
          <div className="buyfor-pricing-container buyfor-pricing-calculator-layout">
            <div className="calculator-copy">
              <span className="buyfor-pricing-eyebrow">
                <CalculatorOutlined />
                Công cụ ước tính
              </span>

              <h2>Tạm tính phí mua hộ</h2>

              <p>
                Nhập giá sản phẩm, số lượng, phí ship nội địa và cân nặng dự
                kiến để xem nhanh tổng chi phí tham khảo.
              </p>

              <div className="calculator-note">
                <WarningOutlined />
                <div>
                  <strong>Lưu ý</strong>
                  <p>
                    Kết quả chỉ là số ước tính. Báo giá chính thức phụ thuộc vào
                    link sản phẩm, phí shop, tình trạng hàng và quy định vận
                    chuyển thực tế.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="calculator-card">
              <div className="calculator-card__head">
                <div>
                  <span>Thông tin đơn hàng</span>
                  <h3>Ước tính chi phí</h3>
                </div>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    setForm({
                      country: "china",
                      productPrice: "",
                      quantity: "1",
                      domesticShipping: "",
                      weight: "",
                      insurance: true,
                    })
                  }
                >
                  <ReloadOutlined />
                  Đặt lại
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="calculator-form-grid">
                <label className="calculator-field calculator-field--full">
                  <span>Thị trường mua hàng</span>
                  <select
                    value={form.country}
                    onChange={(event) => updateField("country", event.target.value)}
                  >
                    {COUNTRIES.map((item) => (
                      <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>
                        {item.name} - {item.currency}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </label>

                <label className="calculator-field">
                  <span>Giá sản phẩm / món ({country.currency})</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    placeholder="Ví dụ: 120"
                    value={form.productPrice}
                    onKeyDown={preventInvalidKey}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      handleNumberChange("productPrice", event.target.value)
                    }
                  />
                </label>

                <label className="calculator-field">
                  <span>Số lượng</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="1"
                    placeholder="Ví dụ: 2"
                    value={form.quantity}
                    onKeyDown={preventInvalidKey}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      handleNumberChange("quantity", event.target.value)
                    }
                  />
                </label>

                <label className="calculator-field">
                  <span>Ship nội địa ({country.currency})</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    placeholder="Ví dụ: 15"
                    value={form.domesticShipping}
                    onKeyDown={preventInvalidKey}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      handleNumberChange("domesticShipping", event.target.value)
                    }
                  />
                </label>

                <label className="calculator-field">
                  <span>Cân nặng dự kiến (kg)</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    step="0.1"
                    placeholder="Ví dụ: 1.5"
                    value={form.weight}
                    onKeyDown={preventInvalidKey}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      handleNumberChange("weight", event.target.value)
                    }
                  />
                </label>
              </div>

              <label className="calculator-insurance">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={form.insurance}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("insurance", event.target.checked)
                  }
                />
                <span>
                  <strong>Đăng ký bảo hiểm hàng hóa</strong>
                  <small>Phí tham khảo 1% trên giá trị hàng hóa quy đổi.</small>
                </span>
              </label>

              <div className="calculator-result">
                <div>
                  <span>Tuyến đang chọn</span>
                  <strong>{country.route}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>Tiền hàng quy đổi</span>
                  <strong>{formatCurrency(calculation.goodsVnd)}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>Phí mua hộ</span>
                  <strong>{formatCurrency(calculation.serviceFee)}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>Phí vận chuyển</span>
                  <strong>{formatCurrency(calculation.freightFee)}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>Phí bảo hiểm</span>
                  <strong>{formatCurrency(calculation.insuranceFee)}</strong>
                </div>
                <div className="calculator-result__total">
                  <span>Tổng chi phí dự kiến</span>
                  <strong>{formatCurrency(calculation.total)}</strong>
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                className="buyfor-pricing-btn buyfor-pricing-btn--primary buyfor-pricing-btn--full"
                onClick={() => navigate("/dich-vu/mua-ho")}
              >
                Tạo yêu cầu mua hộ
                <ArrowRightOutlined />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="buyfor-pricing-section">
          <div className="buyfor-pricing-container">
            <div className="buyfor-pricing-heading buyfor-pricing-heading--center">
              <span>Lưu ý bảng giá</span>
              <h2>Thông tin cần biết trước khi đặt mua hộ</h2>
            </div>

            <div className="buyfor-pricing-note-grid">
              {NOTES.map((note) => (
                <article key={note}>
                  <InfoCircleOutlined />
                  <p>{note}</p>
                </article>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="buyfor-pricing-cta">
          <div className="buyfor-pricing-container buyfor-pricing-cta__inner">
            <div>
              <span>Sẵn sàng đặt hàng?</span>
              <h2>Gửi link sản phẩm để nhận báo giá mua hộ</h2>
              <p>
                Nhân viên sẽ kiểm tra link, phí nội địa, tồn kho và gửi báo giá
                rõ ràng trước khi bạn xác nhận thanh toán.
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              className="buyfor-pricing-btn buyfor-pricing-btn--light"
              onClick={() => navigate("/dich-vu/mua-ho")}
            >
              Tạo yêu cầu mua hộ
              <ArrowRightOutlined />
            </button>
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>
    </>
  );
};

export default BuyForMePricing;

CSS
:root {
  --bf-price-primary: #1557c0;
  --bf-price-primary-dark: #0b2d62;
  --bf-price-accent: #ef3340;
  --bf-price-text: #172033;
  --bf-price-muted: #718096;
  --bf-price-border: #e2e8f0;
  --bf-price-soft: #f6f8fc;
  --bf-price-white: #ffffff;
  --bf-price-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(15, 32, 63, 0.12);
}

.buyfor-pricing-page,
.buyfor-pricing-page * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.buyfor-pricing-page {
  min-height: 100vh;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--bf-price-text);
  background: #ffffff;
  font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
}

.buyfor-pricing-container {
  width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 40px));
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.buyfor-pricing-hero {
  position: relative;
  padding: 64px 0 96px;
  color: #ffffff;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 84% 10%, rgba(69, 139, 255, 0.32), transparent 30%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 8% 90%, rgba(239, 51, 64, 0.22), transparent 26%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, #061832 0%, #0b2e62 48%, #0e4c9c 100%);
}

.buyfor-pricing-hero::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  opacity: 0.13;
  pointer-events: none;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 48px 48px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-hero__inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 430px;
  gap: 64px;
  align-items: center;
}

.buyfor-pricing-breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 9px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.68);
  font-size: 14px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-breadcrumb button {
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.buyfor-pricing-breadcrumb button:hover,
.buyfor-pricing-breadcrumb strong {
  color: #ffffff;
}

.buyfor-pricing-eyebrow {
  width: fit-content;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  padding: 9px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  color: #dbeafe;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}

.buyfor-pricing-hero h1 {
  max-width: 780px;
  margin: 22px 0 20px;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: clamp(42px, 5.6vw, 72px);
  line-height: 1.02;
  letter-spacing: -0.055em;
}

.buyfor-pricing-hero h1 span {
  display: block;
  color: #93c5fd;
}

.buyfor-pricing-hero p {
  max-width: 650px;
  margin: 0;
  color: rgba(239, 246, 255, 0.82);
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.buyfor-pricing-hero__actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 34px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-btn {
  min-height: 52px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 15px;
  padding: 0 22px;
  font-weight: 900;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: 0.22s ease;
}

.buyfor-pricing-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.buyfor-pricing-btn--primary {
  color: #ffffff;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ef3340, #f97316);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(239, 51, 64, 0.28);
}

.buyfor-pricing-btn--secondary {
  color: #ffffff;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}

.buyfor-pricing-btn--light {
  color: var(--bf-price-primary-dark);
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 35px rgba(0, 25, 70, 0.2);
}

.buyfor-pricing-btn--full {
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 18px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-hero__card {
  padding: 26px;
  border-radius: 30px;
  color: var(--bf-price-text);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
  box-shadow: 0 34px 90px rgba(0, 18, 55, 0.34);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
}

.buyfor-pricing-card-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  padding-bottom: 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bf-price-border);
}

.buyfor-pricing-card-top > span {
  width: 54px;
  height: 54px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 18px;
  color: #ffffff;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1557c0, #0b2d62);
  font-size: 25px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-card-top small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--bf-price-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.buyfor-pricing-card-top strong {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 22px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-preview {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 22px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-preview div {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 15px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: #f7f9fc;
}

.buyfor-pricing-preview span {
  color: var(--bf-price-muted);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.buyfor-pricing-preview strong {
  color: var(--bf-price-primary-dark);
  font-size: 14px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-rating {
  display: flex;

  color: #f59e0b;
}

.buyfor-pricing-rating span {
  margin-left: 8px;

  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.buyfor-pricing-section {
  padding: 92px 0;
}

.buyfor-pricing-section--soft {
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 12% 0%, rgba(21, 87, 192, 0.08), transparent 32rem),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #f8fafc 0%, #ffffff 100%);
}

.buyfor-pricing-heading {
  max-width: 760px;
  margin-bottom: 42px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-heading--center {
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  text-align: center;
}

.buyfor-pricing-heading > span {

  color: var(--bf-price-primary);

  font-weight: 950;

}

.buyfor-pricing-heading h2 {

.buyfor-pricing-grid {

.buyfor-pricing-country-card {

.buyfor-pricing-country-card:hover {

.buyfor-pricing-country-card.is-popular {

}

.popular-badge {

.country-card-icon {

.country-card-price {

.country-card-price span {

.country-card-price strong {

.buyfor-pricing-country-card button {

.buyfor-pricing-country-card button:hover {

.buyfor-pricing-info-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.95fr) minmax(420px, 1.05fr);

}

.buyfor-pricing-formula {
  display: flex;

  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;

}

.buyfor-pricing-formula strong {

}

.buyfor-pricing-formula span {

.buyfor-pricing-formula p {
  margin: 0;

}

.buyfor-pricing-step-list {
  display: grid;

}

.buyfor-pricing-step-list article {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 20px;
  border-radius: 22px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid var(--bf-price-border);
  box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(15, 32, 63, 0.06);
}

.buyfor-pricing-step-list article > span {
  width: 46px;
  height: 46px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border-radius: 15px;
  background: #eaf3ff;
  color: var(--bf-price-primary);
  font-weight: 950;
}

.buyfor-pricing-step-list strong {
  display: block;
  color: #172033;
  font-size: 16px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-step-list p {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  color: var(--bf-price-muted);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.buyfor-pricing-calculator-section {
  color: #ffffff;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 12% 15%, rgba(69, 139, 255, 0.25), transparent 28%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, #061832 0%, #0b2e62 55%, #0e4c9c 100%);
}

.buyfor-pricing-calculator-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.82fr) minmax(520px, 1.18fr);
  gap: 70px;
  align-items: center;
}

.calculator-copy h2 {
  margin: 18px 0 16px;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: clamp(34px, 4vw, 52px);
  line-height: 1.08;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
}

.calculator-copy > p {
  margin: 0;
  color: rgba(239, 246, 255, 0.78);
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.calculator-note {
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 28px;
  padding: 18px;
  border-radius: 18px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.calculator-note > span {
  color: #fbbf24;

}

.calculator-note strong {
  color: #ffffff;
}

.calculator-note p {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  color: rgba(239, 246, 255, 0.72);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.calculator-card {
  padding: 30px;
  border-radius: 30px;
  color: var(--bf-price-text);
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 34px 90px rgba(0, 18, 55, 0.35);
}

.calculator-card__head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.calculator-card__head span {
  display: block;
  color: var(--bf-price-primary);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 950;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.calculator-card__head h3 {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  font-size: 24px;
}

.calculator-card__head button {
  height: 38px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  color: var(--bf-price-muted);
  background: #f1f5f9;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 900;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.calculator-form-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
}

.calculator-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}

.calculator-field--full {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.calculator-field span {
  color: #334155;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.calculator-field input,
.calculator-field select {
  width: 100%;
  height: 48px;
  border: 1px solid #dce3ed;
  border-radius: 13px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  outline: none;
  color: #172033;
  background: #ffffff;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.calculator-field input:focus,
.calculator-field select:focus {
  border-color: var(--bf-price-primary);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(21, 87, 192, 0.1);
}

.calculator-insurance {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 18px;
  padding: 15px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: #f7fbff;
  border: 1px solid #dce7f4;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.calculator-insurance input {
  margin-top: 3px;
  accent-color: var(--bf-price-primary);
}

.calculator-insurance strong,
.calculator-insurance small {
  display: block;
}

.calculator-insurance small {
  margin-top: 4px;
  color: var(--bf-price-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.calculator-result {
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 20px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: #f7f9fc;
  border: 1px solid #e1e8f1;
}

.calculator-result > div {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 9px 0;
  color: var(--bf-price-muted);
  font-size: 13px;
}

.calculator-result strong {
  color: #172033;
  text-align: right;
}

.calculator-result__total {
  margin-top: 10px;
  padding-top: 16px !important;
  border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1;
}

.calculator-result__total span {
  color: #172033;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.calculator-result__total strong {
  color: var(--bf-price-accent);
  font-size: 24px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-note-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 18px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-note-grid article {
  min-height: 190px;
  padding: 24px;
  border-radius: 24px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid var(--bf-price-border);
  box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(15, 32, 63, 0.06);
}

.buyfor-pricing-note-grid .anticon {
  width: 46px;
  height: 46px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 15px;
  color: var(--bf-price-primary);
  background: #eaf3ff;
  font-size: 22px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-note-grid p {
  margin: 18px 0 0;
  color: var(--bf-price-muted);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.buyfor-pricing-cta {
  padding: 72px 0;
  color: #ffffff;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0b2d62, #1557c0 65%, #ef3340);
}

.buyfor-pricing-cta__inner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 40px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-cta span {
  color: #bfdbfe;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 950;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.buyfor-pricing-cta h2 {
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  font-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 46px);
  line-height: 1.12;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
}

.buyfor-pricing-cta p {
  max-width: 700px;
  margin: 15px 0 0;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
  line-height: 1.7;
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .buyfor-pricing-hero__inner,
  .buyfor-pricing-info-layout,
  .buyfor-pricing-calculator-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .buyfor-pricing-grid,
  .buyfor-pricing-note-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .buyfor-pricing-hero__card {
    max-width: 520px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .buyfor-pricing-container {
    width: min(100% - 28px, 1180px);
  }

  .buyfor-pricing-hero {
    padding: 42px 0 70px;
  }

  .buyfor-pricing-hero h1 {
    font-size: 40px;
  }

  .buyfor-pricing-hero__actions,
  .buyfor-pricing-cta__inner {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
  }

  .buyfor-pricing-btn {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .buyfor-pricing-section {
    padding: 68px 0;
  }

  .buyfor-pricing-grid,
  .buyfor-pricing-note-grid,
  .calculator-form-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .calculator-field--full {
    grid-column: auto;
  }

  .calculator-card {
    padding: 22px;
    border-radius: 22px;
  }

  .calculator-card__head {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .calculator-result > div {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 5px;
  }

  .calculator-result strong {
    text-align: left;
  }
}

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  ArrowRightOutlined,
  CalculatorOutlined,
  DollarOutlined,
  GlobalOutlined,
  InfoCircleOutlined,
  ReloadOutlined,
  ShoppingCartOutlined,
  StarFilled,
  WarningOutlined,
} from "@ant-design/icons";

import Header from "../../layouts/HeaderLayout/Headeer";
import "./BuyForMePricing.css";

const COUNTRIES = [
  {

  },

const NOTES = [
  "Bảng giá chỉ mang tính tham khảo, phí chính thức phụ thuộc link sản phẩm và phí nội địa.",
  "Hàng giá trị cao, hàng thương hiệu hoặc hàng đặc thù có thể cần kiểm tra riêng.",
  "Phí vận chuyển quốc tế được tính theo cân nặng thực tế hoặc cân quy đổi nếu có.",
  "Có thể phát sinh phí đóng gói, bảo hiểm hoặc phụ phí xử lý với một số nhóm hàng.",

const formatCurrency = (value) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("vi-VN", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "VND",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(value || 0);

const safeNumber = (value) => {
  const number = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(number) && number > 0 ? number : 0;
};

const BuyForMePricing = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    country: "china",
    productPrice: "",
    quantity: "1",
    domesticShipping: "",
    weight: "",
    insurance: true,
  });

  const country =
    COUNTRIES.find((item) => item.id === form.country) || COUNTRIES[0];

  const calculation = useMemo(() => {
    const productPrice = safeNumber(form.productPrice);
    const quantity = Math.max(1, Math.floor(safeNumber(form.quantity) || 1));
    const domesticShipping = safeNumber(form.domesticShipping);
    const weight = safeNumber(form.weight);

    const goodsForeign = productPrice * quantity + domesticShipping;
    const goodsVnd = goodsForeign * country.exchangeRate;

    const serviceFee = goodsVnd
      ? Math.max(goodsVnd * country.serviceRate, country.minFee)
      : 0;

    const freightFee = weight
      ? Math.max(weight * country.freight, country.freight * 0.5)
      : 0;

    const insuranceFee = form.insurance && goodsVnd ? goodsVnd * 0.01 : 0;

    return {
      goodsVnd,
      serviceFee,
      freightFee,
      insuranceFee,
      total: goodsVnd + serviceFee + freightFee + insuranceFee,
    };
  }, [form, country]);

  const updateField = (field, value) => {
    setForm((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [field]: value,
    }));
  };

  const handleNumberChange = (field, value) => {
    if (value === "" || Number(value) >= 0) {
      updateField(field, value);
    }
  };

  const preventInvalidKey = (event) => {
    if (["e", "E", "+", "-"].includes(event.key)) {
      event.preventDefault();
    }
  };

  const scrollToCalculator = () => {
    document
      .getElementById("buyfor-pricing-calculator")
      ?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Header />

      <main className="buyfor-pricing-page">
        <section className="buyfor-pricing-hero">
          <div className="buyfor-pricing-container buyfor-pricing-hero__inner">
            <div>
              <div className="buyfor-pricing-breadcrumb">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => navigate("/")}>
                  Trang chủ
                </button>
                <span>/</span>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => navigate("/bang-gia")}>
                  Bảng giá
                </button>
                <span>/</span>
                <strong>Bảng giá mua hộ</strong>
              </div>

              <span className="buyfor-pricing-eyebrow">
                <DollarOutlined />
                Bảng giá dịch vụ mua hộ
              </span>

              <h1>
                Chi phí mua hộ minh bạch
                <span> trước khi xác nhận đơn</span>
              </h1>

              <p>
                Tham khảo phí mua hộ theo từng thị trường, phí vận chuyển dự
                kiến và các khoản có thể phát sinh khi đặt hàng quốc tế về Việt
                Nam.
              </p>

              <div className="buyfor-pricing-hero__actions">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="buyfor-pricing-btn buyfor-pricing-btn--primary"
                  onClick={scrollToCalculator}
                >
                  Tính phí dự kiến
                  <CalculatorOutlined />
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="buyfor-pricing-btn buyfor-pricing-btn--secondary"
                  onClick={() => navigate("/dich-vu/mua-ho")}
                >
                  Xem dịch vụ mua hộ
                  <ArrowRightOutlined />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="buyfor-pricing-hero__card">
              <div className="buyfor-pricing-card-top">
                <span>
                  <ShoppingCartOutlined />
                </span>
                <div>
                  <small>Ước tính đơn hàng</small>
                  <strong>Order quốc tế</strong>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="buyfor-pricing-preview">
                <div>
                  <span>Tiền hàng</span>
                  <strong>{formatCurrency(1850000)}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>Phí mua hộ từ</span>
                  <strong>3% - 5%</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>Vận chuyển từ</span>
                  <strong>{formatCurrency(68000)}/kg</strong>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="buyfor-pricing-rating">
                <StarFilled />
                <StarFilled />
                <StarFilled />
                <StarFilled />
                <StarFilled />
                <span>Báo giá trước khi đặt mua</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="buyfor-pricing-section">
          <div className="buyfor-pricing-container">
            <div className="buyfor-pricing-heading">
              <span>Bảng phí theo thị trường</span>
              <h2>Phí mua hộ được tính theo giá trị hàng hóa</h2>
              <p>
                Mỗi quốc gia có tỷ giá, phí tối thiểu và đơn giá vận chuyển
                khác nhau. Bạn có thể chỉnh lại dữ liệu này theo bảng giá thật.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="buyfor-pricing-grid">
              {COUNTRIES.map((item) => (
                <article
                  className={`buyfor-pricing-country-card ${
                    item.popular ? "is-popular" : ""
                  }`}
                  key={item.id}
                >
                  {item.popular && (
                    <span className="popular-badge">Phổ biến</span>
                  )}

                  <div className="country-card-icon">
                    <GlobalOutlined />
                  </div>

                  <h3>{item.route}</h3>
                  <p>Thời gian dự kiến: {item.time}</p>

                  <div className="country-card-price">
                    <div>
                      <span>Phí mua hộ</span>
                      <strong>{Math.round(item.serviceRate * 100)}%</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span>Phí tối thiểu</span>
                      <strong>{formatCurrency(item.minFee)}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span>Vận chuyển từ</span>
                      <strong>{formatCurrency(item.freight)}/kg</strong>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      updateField("country", item.id);
                      setTimeout(scrollToCalculator, 60);
                    }}
                  >
                    Tính phí tuyến này
                    <ArrowRightOutlined />
                  </button>
                </article>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section
          className="buyfor-pricing-section buyfor-pricing-calculator-section"
          id="buyfor-pricing-calculator"
        >
          <div className="buyfor-pricing-container buyfor-pricing-calculator-layout">
            <div className="calculator-copy">
              <span className="buyfor-pricing-eyebrow">
                <CalculatorOutlined />
                Công cụ ước tính
              </span>

              <h2>Tạm tính phí mua hộ</h2>

              <p>
                Nhập giá sản phẩm, số lượng, phí ship nội địa và cân nặng dự
                kiến để xem nhanh tổng chi phí tham khảo.
              </p>

              <div className="calculator-note">
                <WarningOutlined />
                <div>
                  <strong>Lưu ý</strong>
                  <p>
                    Kết quả chỉ là số ước tính. Báo giá chính thức phụ thuộc
                    link sản phẩm, phí shop, tình trạng hàng và quy định vận
                    chuyển thực tế.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="calculator-card">
              <div className="calculator-card__head">
                <div>
                  <span>Thông tin đơn hàng</span>
                  <h3>Ước tính chi phí</h3>
                </div>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    setForm({
                      country: "china",
                      productPrice: "",
                      quantity: "1",
                      domesticShipping: "",
                      weight: "",
                      insurance: true,
                    })
                  }
                >
                  <ReloadOutlined />
                  Đặt lại
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="calculator-form-grid">
                <label className="calculator-field calculator-field--full">
                  <span>Thị trường mua hàng</span>
                  <select
                    value={form.country}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      updateField("country", event.target.value)
                    }
                  >
                    {COUNTRIES.map((item) => (
                      <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>
                        {item.name} - {item.currency}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </label>

                <label className="calculator-field">
                  <span>Giá sản phẩm / món ({country.currency})</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    placeholder="Ví dụ: 120"
                    value={form.productPrice}
                    onKeyDown={preventInvalidKey}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      handleNumberChange("productPrice", event.target.value)
                    }
                  />
                </label>

                <label className="calculator-field">
                  <span>Số lượng</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="1"
                    placeholder="Ví dụ: 2"
                    value={form.quantity}
                    onKeyDown={preventInvalidKey}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      handleNumberChange("quantity", event.target.value)
                    }
                  />
                </label>

                <label className="calculator-field">
                  <span>Ship nội địa ({country.currency})</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    placeholder="Ví dụ: 15"
                    value={form.domesticShipping}
                    onKeyDown={preventInvalidKey}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      handleNumberChange(
                        "domesticShipping",
                        event.target.value,
                      )
                    }
                  />
                </label>

                <label className="calculator-field">
                  <span>Cân nặng dự kiến (kg)</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    step="0.1"
                    placeholder="Ví dụ: 1.5"
                    value={form.weight}
                    onKeyDown={preventInvalidKey}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      handleNumberChange("weight", event.target.value)
                    }
                  />
                </label>
              </div>

              <label className="calculator-insurance">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={form.insurance}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("insurance", event.target.checked)
                  }
                />
                <span>
                  <strong>Đăng ký bảo hiểm hàng hóa</strong>
                  <small>
                    Phí tham khảo 1% trên giá trị hàng hóa quy đổi.
                  </small>
                </span>
              </label>

              <div className="calculator-result">
                <div>
                  <span>Tuyến đang chọn</span>
                  <strong>{country.route}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>Tiền hàng quy đổi</span>
                  <strong>{formatCurrency(calculation.goodsVnd)}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>Phí mua hộ</span>
                  <strong>{formatCurrency(calculation.serviceFee)}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>Phí vận chuyển</span>
                  <strong>{formatCurrency(calculation.freightFee)}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>Phí bảo hiểm</span>
                  <strong>{formatCurrency(calculation.insuranceFee)}</strong>
                </div>
                <div className="calculator-result__total">
                  <span>Tổng chi phí dự kiến</span>
                  <strong>{formatCurrency(calculation.total)}</strong>
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                className="buyfor-pricing-btn buyfor-pricing-btn--primary buyfor-pricing-btn--full"
                onClick={() => navigate("/dich-vu/mua-ho")}
              >
                Tạo yêu cầu mua hộ
                <ArrowRightOutlined />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="buyfor-pricing-section">
          <div className="buyfor-pricing-container">
            <div className="buyfor-pricing-heading buyfor-pricing-heading--center">
              <span>Lưu ý bảng giá</span>
              <h2>Thông tin cần biết trước khi đặt mua hộ</h2>
            </div>

            <div className="buyfor-pricing-note-grid">
              {NOTES.map((note) => (
                <article key={note}>
                  <InfoCircleOutlined />
                  <p>{note}</p>
                </article>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="buyfor-pricing-cta">
          <div className="buyfor-pricing-container buyfor-pricing-cta__inner">
            <div>
              <span>Sẵn sàng đặt hàng?</span>
              <h2>Gửi link sản phẩm để nhận báo giá mua hộ</h2>
              <p>
                Nhân viên sẽ kiểm tra link, phí nội địa, tồn kho và gửi báo giá
                rõ ràng trước khi bạn xác nhận thanh toán.
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              className="buyfor-pricing-btn buyfor-pricing-btn--light"
              onClick={() => navigate("/dich-vu/mua-ho")}
            >
              Tạo yêu cầu mua hộ
              <ArrowRightOutlined />
            </button>
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>
    </>
  );
};

export default BuyForMePricing;

BuyForMePricing.css

CSS
:root {
  --bf-price-primary: #1557c0;
  --bf-price-primary-dark: #0b2d62;
  --bf-price-accent: #ef3340;
  --bf-price-text: #172033;
  --bf-price-muted: #718096;
  --bf-price-border: #e2e8f0;
  --bf-price-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(15, 32, 63, 0.12);
}

.buyfor-pricing-page,
.buyfor-pricing-page * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.buyfor-pricing-page {
  min-height: 100vh;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--bf-price-text);
  background: #ffffff;
  font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
}

.buyfor-pricing-container {
  width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 40px));
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.buyfor-pricing-hero {
  position: relative;
  padding: 64px 0 96px;
  color: #ffffff;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 84% 10%, rgba(69, 139, 255, 0.32), transparent 30%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 8% 90%, rgba(239, 51, 64, 0.22), transparent 26%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, #061832 0%, #0b2e62 48%, #0e4c9c 100%);
}

.buyfor-pricing-hero::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  opacity: 0.13;
  pointer-events: none;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 48px 48px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-hero__inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 430px;
  gap: 64px;
  align-items: center;
}

.buyfor-pricing-breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 9px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.68);
  font-size: 14px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-breadcrumb button {
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.buyfor-pricing-breadcrumb button:hover,
.buyfor-pricing-breadcrumb strong {
  color: #ffffff;
}

.buyfor-pricing-eyebrow {
  width: fit-content;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  padding: 9px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  color: #dbeafe;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.buyfor-pricing-hero h1 {
  max-width: 780px;
  margin: 22px 0 20px;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: clamp(42px, 5.6vw, 72px);
  line-height: 1.02;
  letter-spacing: -0.055em;
}

.buyfor-pricing-hero h1 span {
  display: block;
  color: #93c5fd;
}

.buyfor-pricing-hero p {
  max-width: 650px;
  margin: 0;
  color: rgba(239, 246, 255, 0.82);
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.buyfor-pricing-hero__actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;

  margin-top: 34px;
}

  transition: 0.22s ease;
}

.buyfor-pricing-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);

.buyfor-pricing-btn--primary {
  color: #ffffff;

  box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(239, 51, 64, 0.28);
}

  color: #ffffff;

}

}

.buyfor-pricing-hero__card {
  padding: 26px;
  border-radius: 30px;
  color: var(--bf-price-text);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
  box-shadow: 0 34px 90px rgba(0, 18, 55, 0.34);
}

.buyfor-pricing-card-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  padding-bottom: 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bf-price-border);
}

.buyfor-pricing-card-top > span {
  width: 54px;
  height: 54px;

}

.buyfor-pricing-card-top small {
  display: block;

  font-weight: 700;
}

  display: block;

  font-size: 22px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-preview {
  display: grid;

  margin-top: 22px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-preview div {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 15px;

}

.buyfor-pricing-preview span {

}

}

.buyfor-pricing-rating {

  margin-top: 22px;

}

.buyfor-pricing-rating span {
  margin-left: 8px;
  color: var(--bf-price-muted);

}

.buyfor-pricing-section {
  padding: 92px 0;
}

.buyfor-pricing-heading {
  max-width: 760px;
  margin-bottom: 42px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-heading--center {
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  text-align: center;
}

.buyfor-pricing-heading > span {
  display: inline-flex;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  color: var(--bf-price-primary);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 950;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.buyfor-pricing-heading h2 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #14213a;
  font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px);
  line-height: 1.14;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
}

.buyfor-pricing-heading p {
  margin: 16px 0 0;
  color: var(--bf-price-muted);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.buyfor-pricing-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 22px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-country-card {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 390px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 26px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bf-price-border);
  border-radius: 26px;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(15, 32, 63, 0.06);
  transition: 0.24s ease;
}

.buyfor-pricing-country-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-7px);
  border-color: rgba(21, 87, 192, 0.32);
  box-shadow: var(--bf-price-shadow);
}

.buyfor-pricing-country-card.is-popular {
  border-color: rgba(239, 51, 64, 0.35);
}

.popular-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: 18px;
  right: 18px;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #fff1f2;
  color: var(--bf-price-accent);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.country-card-icon {
  width: 54px;
  height: 54px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
  border-radius: 18px;
  color: var(--bf-price-primary);
  background: #eaf3ff;
  font-size: 24px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-country-card h3 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #172033;
  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.buyfor-pricing-country-card p {
  margin: 11px 0 20px;
  color: var(--bf-price-muted);
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.country-card-price {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: auto;
}

.country-card-price div {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed #dce5f0;
}

.country-card-price span {
  color: var(--bf-price-muted);
  font-size: 13px;
}

.country-card-price strong {
  color: var(--bf-price-primary-dark);
  font-size: 13px;
  text-align: right;
}

.buyfor-pricing-country-card button {
  min-height: 46px;
  margin-top: 20px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  color: var(--bf-price-primary);
  background: #f0f7ff;

.buyfor-pricing-calculator-section {

}

.buyfor-pricing-calculator-layout {

}

.calculator-copy h2 {

  font-size: clamp(34px, 4vw, 52px);

}

.calculator-copy > p {

}

.calculator-note > span {

.calculator-card {

}

.calculator-card__head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;

}

.calculator-card__head span {
  display: block;
  color: var(--bf-price-primary);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 950;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.calculator-card__head h3 {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  font-size: 24px;
}

.calculator-card__head button {
  height: 38px;

  background: #f1f5f9;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 900;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.calculator-form-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
}

.calculator-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}

.calculator-field--full {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.calculator-field span {
  color: #334155;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.calculator-field input,
.calculator-field select {
  width: 100%;
  height: 48px;
  border: 1px solid #dce3ed;
  border-radius: 13px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  outline: none;
  color: #172033;
  background: #ffffff;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.calculator-field input:focus,
.calculator-field select:focus {
  border-color: var(--bf-price-primary);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(21, 87, 192, 0.1);
}

.calculator-insurance {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 18px;
  padding: 15px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: #f7fbff;
  border: 1px solid #dce7f4;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.calculator-insurance input {
  margin-top: 3px;
  accent-color: var(--bf-price-primary);
}

.calculator-insurance strong,
.calculator-insurance small {
  display: block;
}

.calculator-insurance small {
  margin-top: 4px;
  color: var(--bf-price-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.calculator-result {
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 20px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: #f7f9fc;
  border: 1px solid #e1e8f1;
}

.calculator-result > div {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 9px 0;
  color: var(--bf-price-muted);
  font-size: 13px;
}

.calculator-result strong {
  color: #172033;
  text-align: right;
}

.calculator-result__total {
  margin-top: 10px;
  padding-top: 16px !important;
  border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1;
}

.calculator-result__total span {
  color: #172033;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.calculator-result__total strong {
  color: var(--bf-price-accent);

}

.buyfor-pricing-note-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 18px;
}

.buyfor-pricing-note-grid article {
  min-height: 190px;
  padding: 24px;
  border-radius: 24px;

}

.buyfor-pricing-note-grid .anticon {
  width: 46px;

}

.buyfor-pricing-note-grid p {

}

.buyfor-pricing-cta {

.buyfor-pricing-cta__inner {

}

.buyfor-pricing-cta span {

.buyfor-pricing-cta h2 {

.buyfor-pricing-cta p {

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .buyfor-pricing-hero__inner,
  .buyfor-pricing-calculator-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .buyfor-pricing-grid,
  .buyfor-pricing-note-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .buyfor-pricing-hero__card {
    max-width: 520px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .buyfor-pricing-container {
    width: min(100% - 28px, 1180px);
  }

  .buyfor-pricing-hero {
    padding: 42px 0 70px;
  }

  .buyfor-pricing-hero h1 {
    font-size: 40px;
  }

  .buyfor-pricing-hero__actions,
  .buyfor-pricing-cta__inner {
    flex-direction: column;

    padding: 68px 0;

  .buyfor-pricing-note-grid,
  .calculator-form-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .calculator-field--full {
    grid-column: auto;
  }

  .calculator-card {
    padding: 22px;
    border-radius: 22px;
  }

  .calculator-card__head {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .calculator-result > div {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 5px;
  }

  .calculator-result strong {
    text-align: left;
  }
}

CSS
:root {
  --pc-primary: #1557c0;
  --pc-dark: #071f45;
  --pc-accent: #ef3340;
  --pc-text: #172033;
  --pc-muted: #64748b;
  --pc-border: #e2e8f0;
  --pc-soft: #f7f9fc;
  --pc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(15, 32, 63, 0.12);
}

.pricing-calculator-page,
.pricing-calculator-page * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.pricing-calculator-page {
  min-height: 100vh;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--pc-text);
  background: #fff;
  font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
}

.pricing-calculator-container {
  width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 40px));
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.pricing-calculator-hero {
  position: relative;
  padding: 64px 0 92px;
  color: #fff;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 82% 16%, rgba(69, 139, 255, 0.32), transparent 30%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 10% 90%, rgba(239, 51, 64, 0.22), transparent 26%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, #061832 0%, #0b2e62 50%, #0e4c9c 100%);
}

.pricing-calculator-hero::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  opacity: 0.13;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 48px 48px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.pricing-calculator-hero__inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 430px;
  gap: 64px;
  align-items: center;
}

.pricing-calculator-breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  font-size: 14px;
}

.pricing-calculator-breadcrumb button {
  border: 0;

  cursor: pointer;
}

.pricing-calculator-breadcrumb button:hover,
.pricing-calculator-breadcrumb strong {
  color: #fff;
}

.pricing-calculator-eyebrow,
.pricing-calculator-kicker {

  border-radius: 999px;
  color: #dbeafe;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);

  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.pricing-calculator-kicker {

.pricing-calculator-hero h1 {

.pricing-calculator-hero p {

}

.pricing-calculator-summary-card {
